scope: P03 post-fix nine sessions in CONDITION_RECEIPT only; source/geometry/event anchors, no model loading, no F1, no label edits
clock_policy: Source timestamps preserved in their native representation. No global clock offset is applied. Unity source epoch timestamps and Wii UTC source timestamps are compared only for conditional runtime overlap. geometry_source_timestamp is not subtracted from Unix epoch source_timestamp. C# FallEventBackendTimestamp is assigned from DateTimeOffset.UtcNow Unix time and compared with Unity source_timestamp UTC epoch; backend receive time is not substituted.
